BaseListing.Description:
Piyuo Counter is an innovative pedestrian detection application designed for users who need accurate foot traffic monitoring. Using advanced AI object detection and tracking technology, this app provides precise counting of pedestrians in various environments without requiring internet connectivity.

Whether you're a business owner researching potential store locations, an urban planner studying movement patterns, or a researcher collecting data, Piyuo Counter delivers consistent and reliable people counting through your device's GPU/NPU processing power.

Simply connect a webcam, use a live stream URL, or upload video files as your source. The intuitive interface makes pedestrian counting accessible to everyone - just position your camera, start the detection, and let the AI do the counting for you.

Eliminate the inconsistencies of manual counting methods with Piyuo Counter's standardized AI detection model. Ideal for retail entrepreneurs evaluating locations, urban planners analyzing traffic patterns, or anyone needing accurate pedestrian flow metrics.

Piyuo Counter transforms complex computer vision technology into an easy-to-use tool for all your people counting needs.
Features: Real-time pedestrian detection and counting using advanced AI models
Additional detection capabilities for vehicles and bicycles
Offline operation - no internet connection required for image recognition
Flexible input options: webcam, RTSP streaming, or network cameras
ible input options: webcam, RTSP streaming, or network cameras Continuous 24-hour monitoring with comprehensive data logging
BaseListing.ShortDescription: Your offline AI pedestrian counting expert. Get accurate foot traffic data without internet. Detects people, vehicles, bikes via webcams, streams, files. Easy analysis for business & planning.
